rationale.conceptual: An established but non-trivial method needing careful implementation – correct choice of pseudopotentials, supercell geometry, relaxation and DOS protocols, and interpretation of orbital-resolved PDOS and spatial extent. Not a novel algorithm, but a multi-component standard computational approach.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline: construct supercells, relax two interfaces, compute multiple DOS files including orbital projections, extract spatial extent, and repeat with four vacancy configurations. Requires managing a scientific software tool (Quantum ESPRESSO) and processing outputs.

Resource needs are moderate for a CPU-based DFT calculation with supercells up to ~200 atoms.
